# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under `tests/fixtures/invoices/` are the ground truth for payload shapes [seed].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in `src/domain/` [note 0].
- All outbound HTTP calls are standardized on axios for interceptor support [qa-s02].

## Logging
- Use winston for structured logging; ops dashboard ingests its log format natively [qa-s05].
- BillingClient retries are logged at warn level via winston [qa-s05].
- Redact sensitive fields (e.g., card numbers) from logs [qa-s04].

## Schemas & Validation
- Invoice and credit-note payloads use zod 3 with `.strict()`; unknown keys are rejected [qa-s03].
- Zod schemas flatten cleanly in the express error handler [qa-s04].
- The express error handler returns 400 for validation failures, 500 otherwise [note 1].

## Known pitfalls
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- Enforce alphabetical import sorting via ESLint to catch merge conflicts early [qa-s01, qa-s03].

# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under `tests/fixtures/invoices/` are the ground truth for payload shapes [seed].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in `src/domain/` [note 0].
- All outbound HTTP calls are standardized on axios for interceptor support [qa-s02].

## Logging
- Use pino for structured logging; winston was retired due to log loss under load [qa-s09].
- Redact sensitive fields (e.g., card numbers) from logs via pino redaction config [qa-s04, qa-s09].

## Schemas & Validation
- Invoice and credit-note payloads use zod 4 with `z.strictObject()`; unknown keys are rejected [qa-s06].
- Zod 4 validation covers query parameters in addition to body payloads [qa-s08].
- The express error handler returns 400 for validation failures, 500 otherwise [note 1].
- Zod error-mapper reads zod 4's issue list (not the legacy error shape) [qa-s06].

## Imports
- Enforce import grouping by type: node builtins, external packages, internal aliases, relative paths [qa-s07].
- Retire alphabetical import sorting; type-grouping is the current convention [qa-s07].

## Known pitfalls
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- Avoid winston for high-throughput logging; pino passed 10-minute soak test with zero loss [qa-s08, qa-s09].
